decisions: Preserve the frozen project cost and schedule; these findings are a separate evidence timeline.
Do not backdate the current Alberta register to 2024 or use CAL-3 announcements as a complete project-register snapshot.
The earliest located announcement is in 2024 Q4; absence of an earlier located source is not evidence of zero earlier spending.
Do not infer realized expenditure from announced investment, construction schedules, capacity, tenant commitments or opening targets.
The 2026 tenant announcement follows every forecast origin in the frozen benchmark and cannot supply an earlier predictor.
